scope: Exact native30device/84R155C C8 pump only. Static imposed public supplies/UP/DOWN/VCTRL. Measures source current including native bias resistors; excludes dynamic PFD edges, VCO loading, parent RC and closed-loop acquisition. No current inferred from logic duty.

nominal.sign_convention: Positive I(VCLAMP) is net pump injection into externally clamped VCTRL; negative is net sink. UP/DOWN increments subtract same-voltage00 bias state.

hot_low.sign_convention: Positive I(VCLAMP) is net pump injection into externally clamped VCTRL; negative is net sink. UP/DOWN increments subtract same-voltage00 bias state.
